78-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
78-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Steel Leaf Paladin by paying its mana cost.
When Steel Leaf Paladin enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

997-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1365-2198-2527-4247-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-4247-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

512-950-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2577-5231-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5231-5478-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5231-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-3249-4871--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-4871--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-4871--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5147-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5147-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5147-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4908-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1491-2033-6218-7741.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3297-6705-7304.manaNeeded: {U} and {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable
3297-6705-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Artificial Evolution by paying its mana cost, changing all instances of "Mutant" on Genghis Frog to "Frog".
Resolve the Genghis Frog ability, creating a Mutagen token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
Repeat step 5.
3297-6705-7304.notes: Step 5 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

1434-2506-4365-7150.description:
Cast Kirol either from your hand or the command zone by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3525-6006-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous Neonate

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control without summoning sickness that cannot be blocked by an opponent.

113-5731.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Celestial Mantle attached. Celestial Mantle triggers, doubling your life total.
If Sorin is on the battlefield as Sorin of House Markov, move to your postcombat main phase. Sorin of House Markov's second ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Sorin, Ravenous Neonate.
Activate Sorin, Ravenous Neonate's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, dealing damage to target opponent equal to the life you gained this turn.

1429-4779-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4779-5958.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

478-804-2821-3301-4249.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3301-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-2821-3301-4249.description:
Animate Candelabra using Tezzeret
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

773-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galazeth Prismari.
When Galazeth Prismari enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Galazeth Prismari that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Galazeth Prismari token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

819-1170-4074-4311-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
819-1170-4074-4311-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Chandra, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1235-4705-4863-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Revolutionist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

141-914-2332-2928.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
141-914-2332-2928.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Step Through by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Step Through, targeting Dockside Extortionist and Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Step Through, returning Dockside Extortionist and Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 5.

2792-3489-4520.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
2792-3489-4520.description:
Declare another nontoken creature as an attacker.
When the creature isn't blocked by an opponent, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjitsu ability by paying {1}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked creature to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping the seven lands.
Activate any creature card in your hand's ninjitsu ability by paying {1}{U}{B} and returning Great Whale to your hand, putting the creature onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 3.

708-2459-4948-5147.notablePrerequisites: Estrid's Invocation is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2459-4948-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

34-813-1181.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying {2}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Footsteps of the Goryo from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3035-3519.manaNeeded: {0}, plus increasingly more for each additional time Nadier has been cast from the command zone beyond the first
3035-3519.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Nadier, adding seven {B} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Choose to put Nadier from exile into the command zone.
Nadier's second ability triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Elf tokens equal to its power.
Cast Nadier by paying {5}{B} plus commander tax.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a 1/1 Elf token, adding {B} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Nadier triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 5 until you control no Elf tokens.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat without exiling the tokens.

45-614-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
45-614-1987-2510.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
